lines.line: OK... ah, it's light... ...it rattles... it's... Travel Scrabble ! Oooohhh, thank you!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: This one's from Joey... feels like a book. Thinks it's a book... feels like a book. And... ...it's a book!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh, it's Dr. Seuss!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: : That book got me through some tough times.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Yes, the doctors say if they remove it, he'll die.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Who's this from?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh, that's Ross's.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh... ... Oh my God. He remembered.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Remembered what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: It was like months ago. We were walking by this antique store, and I saw this pin in the window, and I told him it was just like one my grandmother had when I was a little girl. Oh! I can't believe he remembered!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Well, sure, but can you play it on a plane?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Oh, it's so pretty. This must have cost him a fortune.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: I can't believe he did this.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Come on, Ross? Remember back in college, when he fell in love with Carol and bought her that ridiculously expensive crystal duck?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: What did you just say?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: ahem... um... Crystal duck.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: No, no, no.... the, um, the... 'love' part?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: F-hah.... flennin....

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh.... my God.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Oh, no-no-no-no-no....

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: That's good, just keep rubbing your head. That'll turn back time.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I mean, this is unbelievable.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: I know. This is really, really huge.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: No it's not. It's small. It's tiny. It's petite. It's wee.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Nuh-uh. I don't think any of our lives are ever gonna be the same ever again.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: OK, is there a mute button on this woman?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: I think this is so great! I mean, you and Ross! D-did you have any idea?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: No! None! I mean, my first night in the city, he mentioned something about asking me out, but nothing ever happened, so I just... : W-well, what else did he say? I mean, does he, like, want to go out with me?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Well, given that he's desperately in love with you, he probably wouldn't mind getting a cup of coffee or something.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Ross? All this time? Well, I've got to talk to him.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: H-He's in China!

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: The country.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: No, no, wait. His flight doesn't leave for another forty-five more minutes.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: What about the time difference?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: From here to the airport?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Yes! You're never gonna make it!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Rachel, what're you gonna say to him?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I-I-I don't know.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Well then maybe you shouldn't go.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: He's right, cause if you're just gonna, like, break his heart, that's the kind of thing that can wait.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Yeah, but if it's good news, you should tell him now.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I don't know. Maybe I'll know when I see him.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Here, look, alright, does this help?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Noooo... look, all I know is that I cannot wait a week until I see him. I mean, this is just too big. Y'know, I just, I've just gotta talk to him. I... I gotta... OK, I'll see you later.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Rachel, I love you! Deal with me first!

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Ni-chou chi-ma!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Ross! Excuse me, pardon me, excuse me....

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Oh, no, no, I don't have one. I just need to talk to my friend.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: No, I know, but I—he just went on. He's right there, he's got the blue jacket on, I... can I j-just...

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: OK, alright, OK, um... then could you please, uh... just give him a message for me? Please? This is very important.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Uh... I don't know.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Heh, heh. It was nothin'.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Uhhh.. y'know what? Forget about me. Let's, uh... let's give you another turn.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Sure! Why not?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: How do you mean?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Uh, so, uh, Rach, uh... do you wanna save this wrapping paper, I mean, it's only a little bit torn... so are you gonna go for it with Ross or should I just throw it out?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I don't know. I don't know... I thought about it all the way there, and I thought about it all the way back... and, uh, oh, you guys, y'know, it's Ross . Y'know what I mean? I mean, it's Ross .

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I don't know, I mean, this is just my initial gut feeling... but I'm thinking... oh, I'm thinking it'd be really great.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Oh my God, me too! Oh! Oh, we'd be like friends-in-law! Y'know what the best part is? The best part is that you already know everything about him! I mean, it's like starting on the fifteenth date!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Yeah, but, y'know, it's... it would be like starting on the fifteenth date.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Another good point.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: No, I mean, I mean, when you're at the fifteenth date, y'know, you're already in a very relationshippy place. Y'know, it's... you're committed.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Huh?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Well, I mean, then what happens if it doesn't work out?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Why isn't it working out?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I don't know... sometimes it doesn't.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Is he not cute enough for you?

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Does he not make enough money?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: No, I'm just....

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.line: Maybe there's someone else.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Wha...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Is there? Is there someone else?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: No! There is.. there is noone else!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Then why the hell are you dumping my brother?!?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Hey, big...

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Shhhh!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: ...spender.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: She's still asleep.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: So how'd it go?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Oh, it was amazing. You know how you always think you're great in bed?

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: The fact that you'd even ask that question shows how little you know me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Well, it's like, last night, I couldn't do the thing that usually makes me great. So I had to do all this other stuff. And the response I got... man, oh man, it was like a ticker tape parade!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Yes, I know, as it happens my room is very very close to the parade route.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: It was amazing! And not just for her... uh-uh. For me, too. It's like, all of a sudden, I'm blind. But all my other senses are heightened, y'know? It's like... I was able to appreciate it on another level.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: I didn't know you had another level.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: I know! Neither did I!

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Hey, great skirt! Birthday present?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Oh, from who?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: From you. I exchanged the blouse you got me.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Well, it's the thought. Hey, doesn't Ross's flight get in in a couple hours? At gate 27-B?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Uh, yeah. Uh, Monica, y'know, honey, I've been thinking about it and I've decided this—this whole Ross thing, it's just not a good idea.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Oh, why?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Because, I feel like I wouldn't just be going out with him. I would be going out with all of you. Oh, and there would just be all this pressure, and I don't wanna...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: No, no, no, no, no, no pressure, no pressure!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Monica, nothing has even happened yet, and you're already so...

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: I am not 'so'! OK, I was a teensy bit weird at first, but... I'll be good. I promise.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Who is it?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: C'mon up.

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.line: Behind my brother's back? ... is exactly the kind of crazy thing you won't be hearing from me.

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Seven hundred bucks!

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Alright, you did it! Do we have any fruit?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: Man, hell of a two weeks, huh? Y'know what, though? I really feel like I learned something.

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.line: Really? So, you're gonna stick with this 'it's all for her' thing?

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.line: What, are you crazy? When a blind man gets his sight back, does he walk around like this?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I can't believe you'd rather go out with him than me.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Would you excuse me, please? I'm trying to have a date here.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Fine, just stop thinking about me.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Can't do it, can you?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: So I'm thinking about you. So what?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I don't get it. What do you see in this guy, anyway?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Well... he happens to be a very nice... guy....

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Rachel, come on. Give us a chance.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Ross, it's too hard.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: No, no, no... why, because it might get weird for everyone else? Who cares about them. This is about us. Look, I-I've been in love with you since, like, the ninth grade.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Ross, you're like my best friend.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: I know.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: If we broke up, and I lost you...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Whoa, whoa, whoa. What makes you think we're gonna break up?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Well, have you been involved with someone where you haven't broken up?

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: No. But... it only has to happen once . Look, you and I both know we are perfect for each other, right? I mean... so, the only question is... are you attracted to me?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I don't know... I mean, I've never looked at you that way before.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Well, start looking.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Wow.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Right! You're right!

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: You know what?

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: I forgot... I am supposed to pick up a friend at the airport. I am so sorry! I'm so... if you want to stay, and finish your drinks, please do.... I mean—I'm sorry. I-I-I gotta go. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.line: Excuse me, pardon me, excuse me, excuse me, sorry. Hi.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Oh, hey, hey, I got that.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: No problem. I cannot wait for you to meet my friends.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Yeah.

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: No, no, they will. I just... uh...

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.line: Come on, they're gonna love you.
